items.title: Josephine Davies interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 14, 2025
items.q: I’m more into Cannonball Adderley and soul jazz personally

ctx.x: I’m glad you said that. You know compared to other free jazz I’ve heard, and I’m more into Cannonball Adderley and soul jazz personally, but your music felt less demonstrative and more inviting I think than a lot of, I’ll still use the term free jazz. It’s an observation, not really a question. Perhaps, I’ve seen some comments on your playing
and they used – the critics used the term “melodic” and “melodies.” And what makes a good melody for you?
